rocprof_mtp_note: rocprofv3 deadlocks at finalize on llama draft-mtp path (second-context/queue); not size/graph dependent. Verify profiled via equivalent batched B+1-row forward (llama-bench -p 4 -b 4).

verify_shape_4row.llama_amortization: batch is a grid dim in mul_mat_vec_q -> each block reads weight tile ONCE, computes all B+1 rows (weight read amortized across verify rows) + dp4a
verify_shape_4row.hipengine_kernels: q8_0_t16_dual_split etc. with blockIdx.y=row -> separate block per row, weight re-read B+1x (NO amortization). WMMA-amortized path slower at rows=4 (56.9 vs 42.3 ms).

attribution: llama MTP uplift advantage = verify is cheaper PER ROW via (a) weight-read amortization across the B+1 batch in mul_mat_vec_q and (b) dp4a. hipEngine per-row exact verify re-reads weights B+1x. NOT AR decode (hipEngine wins AR).
lever: vec-rowtile verify GEMV for q8_0 attn + q4_k/q5_k/q6_k MoE (read weight once, accumulate B+1 rows in registers) - the EXACT pattern that won for the Q6_K lm-head rowtile, at exact precision (no dp4a/ja-gate risk). Untested for the verify GEMVs (only WMMA tried, which is slower).
